goal: Bootstrap the project, configure tooling, define the database schema, and set up authentication and i18n.
summary: Phase 1 completed. Foundation in place: Next.js 14.2.35 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4.17 + shadcn/ui, Prisma 6.19.3 with SQLite schema and seed, NextAuth v4 credentials auth, next-intl en/zh-Hant routing, shared locale layout with nav/footer/language switcher, admin login page with working error feedback, and a minimal admin dashboard shell at /[locale]/admin. Build, lint, and seed all pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Initialize Next.js 14+ with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, App Router; install shadcn/ui and base components. Creates package.json, app/, components/ui/, lib/, prisma/. [verified]
  2. Configure Prisma with SQLite and define schema for User, Course, Booking, BlogPost, SiteContent, Payment, and Availability. Creates prisma/schema.prisma and a seed script. [verified]
  3. Configure NextAuth.js/Auth.js credentials provider for admin login; add admin seed script at scripts/seed.ts. Creates app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts. [verified]
  4. Configure next-intl with messages/en.json and messages/zh-Hant.json; set up middleware.ts and locale routing. Creates i18n config files. [verified]
  5. Add shared layout with navigation shell, footer, and language switcher. Creates app/[locale]/layout.tsx and components/layout/. [verified]
evidence: All 5 steps completed. Added app/[locale]/admin/login/page.tsx and components/admin-login-form.tsx using signIn with redirect: false so login errors are displayed. Added app/[locale]/admin/page.tsx as the post-login destination. Updated lib/auth.ts signIn path to /en/admin/login. Verified `test -f app/[locale]/admin/page.tsx` and `grep -q 'redirect: false' components/admin-login-form.tsx`. Build passes and generates /[locale]/admin and /[locale]/admin/login; lint exits 0; seed creates admin + sample course.
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Every step included real behavioral verification: npm run build, npx prisma migrate dev, npm run db:seed. Login form uses redirect: false and surfaces errors; admin dashboard page exists. Lint uses installed eslint and passes.
gateVerdicts.evidence: Build passed; `grep -q 'redirect: false' components/admin-login-form.tsx`; `test -f app/[locale]/admin/page.tsx`; migration created dev.db; seed upserted admin; `npm run lint` exits 0.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Combined output delivers the phase goal: project scaffolding, database schema, auth, i18n, admin login, and admin dashboard shell are functional and build cleanly.
gateVerdicts.evidence: npm run build exits 0 and registers /[locale]/admin and /[locale]/admin/login; app/[locale]/layout.tsx renders with nav/footer/language switcher; /api/auth/[...nextauth] route registered; Prisma client generated.

gateVerdicts.rationale: Nothing deferred. Next.js downgrade recorded as decision D001. Admin login/dashboard additions were made to wire the auth gate during phase completion.
gateVerdicts.evidence: Decision D001 documented; no remaining steps; admin login and dashboard pages now exist.
